description: Tolerances for comparing Path A (Agent Teams) vs Path B (parallel subagents fallback) outcomes on the post-implementation parallel group.

artifacts.spec_md.rationale: Post-impl does not modify spec.md; bytes must match exactly across paths.

artifacts.plan_md.rationale: Post-impl does not modify plan.md; bytes must match exactly.

artifacts.tasks_md.rationale: Post-impl does not modify tasks.md; bytes must match exactly.

workflow.post_impl_checklist.row_count.rationale: Both paths produce exactly one row per task (10/11/12/13/14).

workflow.post_impl_checklist.statuses.rationale: PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED per task must match across paths — equivalent inputs produce equivalent gate outcomes.

workflow.post_impl_checklist.findings_te.rationale: LLM-driven prose; allow paraphrase but require semantic equivalence (no contradictory findings).

gate_results.G0_through_G7.rationale: All 8 gates must return identical PASS/FAIL across paths.

workflow.pr_packet_validation.status.rationale: Both paths must stop at the same missing-packet boundary before PR creation.

workflow.pr_packet_validation.packet_pat.rationale: Both paths require the same feature-local packet path and never use a linked-worktree .git child path.

workflow.pr_packet_validation.validator_.rationale: The validator remains not_run when the required current packet is absent.

workflow.pr_packet_validation.writes_sta.rationale: Neither path may claim that read-only packet validation persisted state.

workflow.pr_packet_validation.blocker.rationale: Both paths report the same packet-emission state before validation or PR creation.

workflow.multi_pr_emission.row_count.rationale: Both paths emit exactly one reviewer evidence row per planned SPEC-908 slice.

workflow.multi_pr_emission.statuses.rationale: Slice opened/blocked/merged/closed status must match across runtime paths for the same input.

workflow.multi_pr_emission.review_order.rationale: Both paths must preserve the SPEC-908 layer-plan order without adding slicing heuristics.

workflow.multi_pr_emission.branch_bases.rationale: Style B branch bases must match across paths: first slice targets the integration base and later slices target the previous slice branch.

consensus_resolution_log.row_count.rationale: LLM non-determinism may produce ±1 row across runs due to consensus mode escape-hatch firing differently.
